This is a pre-existing representation note; R2 did not change it. The Go table is a slice, and both the new 01 guard and the 08e0 04 guard count len(slice), including duplicate tuples. The design table is a frozenset, so 17 slice entries with duplicates have no exact design analog: their distinct set may have <= 16 members. Go refuses such an input as OWNERSHIP / 01. This is fail-closed and only stricter, so it belongs with the I2 family. A future contract delta may state that the private table is duplicate-free or is counted by entries.
